page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals average multi-core performance alongside weaker single-core capabilities. The stress-ng single-core CPU test scores in the bottom 25% at 1313.59, whereas the multi-core CPU test reaches an average tier of 7001.83. Memory bandwidth remains consistently in the average range, with read-only small block cached speeds at 389.74 GB/sec and uncached large block write speeds at 37.35 GB/sec. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression benchmarks fall into the bottom 25%, indicating a performance bottleneck for sequential, single-threaded operations.

The instance supports advanced instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512, and AES, which assist in cryptographic and vector calculations. However, the lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may impact I/O-heavy workloads. Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-core processing capabilities, this instance is configured for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory footprints, such as static web serving, software compilation, and basic database operations.
